card.name: Words just before a medical history item
card.fires_on: Linking or modifying words right after 'history of', 'patients with', 'pre-' or 'review of', where a condition or finding is about to be named, e.g. 'of', 'severe', 'normal', 'on'.

modes.label: After history or review
modes.description: The word 'of' or a modifier right after 'history' or 'review', before the named condition.
modes.example: or history<< of>> a large acetaminophen ingestion;

modes.label: After patients with
modes.description: A modifier or small word after 'patients with' or 'with', before a disease or lab finding.
modes.example: is recommended for patients with<< severe>> liver impairment (Child-Pugh Class C

modes.label: Inside a condition phrase
modes.description: A word within a pre-existing condition or a surgical-history phrase.
modes.example: in patients with pre<<-existing>> renal disease.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd rare tokens and pushes down the word history, so it avoids repeating 'history' where a condition should follow.
card.plain: It fires on small words that lead into a patient's past condition or risk factor, just before the condition is named.
